questions.question: A merge sort divides 4 elements into equal halves until singletons. How many split levels are there?
questions.explanation: Each level halves the size; count halvings until one remains.

questions.question: How many elements are in each half after the first split of 4 elements?
questions.explanation: An even-sized input splits into equal halves.

questions.question: How many total elements result from merging sorted lists of lengths 2 and 2?
questions.explanation: Merging preserves every element, including duplicates.

questions.question: For a sorted array of 4 elements, recursive binary search has low > high. What should it return?
questions.explanation: An empty candidate interval is the unsuccessful base case.
